result.title: Data Attribution Should Steer Pretraining
result.comment: Accepted to the 3rd Workshop on Attributing Model Behavior at Scale: Data Attribution and Provenance (ATTRIB 2026) at NeurIPS 2026, Idea Track. 4 pages main text, 13 pages total, 1 figure, 2 tables
result.summary: Pretraining data curation decides what a model learns from, yet what makes a document worth learning from depends on what the model already knows. Influence-driven selectors already rank documents to improve one run; we argue that training-data attribution should steer pretraining by identifying testable data properties that become reusable curation criteria, evaluated on new data against cheaper selectors at matched total cost, discovery included. A document ranking is consumed by the run it was computed for, whereas an explained data property can be tested across corpora and checkpoints, especially where familiar quality signals diverge from measured usefulness. Because historical contribution, an understandable explanation, and future data value require distinct evidence, we specify a feedback loop that interprets attributed sources, tests candidate data changes, and states for five claim types what evidence each requires and what none establishes. We close with a falsifiable comparison against perplexity, classifier, and mixing baselines at equal total compute.

AI.brief_summary: 这是一篇立场论文，主张预训练数据归因不止于一次性文档排序，而应提炼可跨语料与检查点检验、可复用的数据属性；并给出一个反馈闭环：解释被归因的数据来源、检验候选数据改动，逐类说明五类主张各需何种证据，最后提出与 perplexity、分类器、配比基线在总计算量匹配下的可反驳对比。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「贡献归因→可检验数据属性」的证据分级与等成本对比框架，可能为 LVR 中推理轨迹训练、视觉证据筛选的贡献分配与监督评价提供方法线索；但工作限于文本预训练数据策展，向多模态 latent 推理的迁移尚需核查。
